'''FDP-6000 Culinary Droids''' were multi-limbed [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droids]] equipped with a variety of kitchen utensils and enough culinary knowledge to be considered a four-star [[Chef/Legends|chef]]. An FDP-6000 was in the service of [[Nebula Consumables]] on [[Sprawl 41]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It contracted the [[Mynock virus]] and attempted to make meals out of [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="MC" />
